about_the_game:
Unleash your strategic genius in Squares Proximity, a captivating 2D turn-based strategy game. Forget multiplayer showdowns; your true test lies in outsmarting a cunning and adaptable AI opponent in a battle of wits and numbers.

The rules are simple: you are given a random number to place on the game board. Each placement is a critical decision, capturing adjacent squares and accumulating points based on your tactical choices. The game continues in turns against the AI until the board is completely filled. Victory belongs to the one with the highest score—every move counts!

Key Features:

  • Challenging AI Opponent: Test your wits against a smart AI designed to adapt and counter your every move. It's not about playing against friends; it's about proving you're smarter than the machine.

  • Customizable Matches: Choose your challenge! Face off against 1, 2, or even 3 AI opponents at once for a truly chaotic and strategic battle on the board.

  • Deep yet Accessible Gameplay: Easy to learn, but with layers of strategic depth that will keep you coming back to master new tactics and improve your high scores.

  • Vibrant Visuals & Effects: Enjoy a colourful and clean aesthetic with satisfying visual and sound effects that make every move feel impactful.

  • Endless Replayability: With a randomized board and numbers each time, no two games are ever the same.

Do you have the tactical mind to conquer the board and emerge as the ultimate strategist? Sharpen your wits, plan your moves, and prove your superiority in Squares Proximity!
